channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Lebanon hopes crunch talks in Washington will halt an Israeli invasion
item.description: What will Israel and Lebanon discuss in Washington, as Hezbollah and Israel continue to battle in south Lebanon.

item.title: US says Iran’s new supreme leader alive and ‘increasingly engaging’
item.description: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio says Iran’s Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei is increasingly engaging in negotiations.

item.title: Iran’s supreme leader appears more active as talks continue: US’s Rubio
item.description: Tehran has agreed to discuss previously off-limits aspects of its nuclear file, US State Secretary tells lawmakers.

item.title: Scene of damaged hospital after Israeli strike in southern Lebanon
item.description: Al Jazeera’s Obaida Hitto is at the scene of Jabal Amel Hospital, which was ‘significantly damaged’ in Israeli attacks.

item.title: Israel strikes southern Lebanon but partial truce with Hezbollah appears to hold
item.description: Israel continues its campaign in the south, though has not struck Beirut after a deal announced by the US.

item.title: British couple lose Iran jail sentence appeal, family says
item.description: Lindsay and Craig Foreman were arrested in January 2025 during a global motorbike journey.

item.title: Two arrested after four migrant farm workers killed in Italy minivan fire
item.description: CCTV images showed two people blocking the van's doors from the outside and throwing liquid inside to start a fire.

item.title: South Africa police investigate killing of two Mozambican men
item.description: The deaths come after a day of violent protests against illegal migration in the town of Mossel Bay.

item.title: Missing lab worker found dead in New Mexico nearly a year after disappearing
item.description: Melissa Casias' case was part of debunked speculations about recent deaths and disappearances in the US scientific community.

item.title: Six people killed in Iowa domestic dispute, police say
item.description: The suspected shooter was found dead near a bridge with a self-inflicted gunshot wound, authorities say.
